properties.entry: Complete any enabled objective to win. Opponents share these objectives. No time limit.
Sandbox — no objective victory or time limit. Losing your last colony after first establishing one eliminates you.
Support for independence: %s / 50%%. Establish a coastal colony, develop your economy and build support. Then declare independence and defeat the invasion.

Independence declared. Occupied colonies: %s. Remaining royal ground units: %s. Recover every surviving colony of your nation and reduce the total royal ground force to at most 2 units. Keep an accessible coastal port; occupation of all coastal colonies or 90%% of residents means defeat.
Acquired discoveries: %s / 25. Produce owls in the agora and acquire knowledge.
Remaining opponents: %s / %s. A rival is eliminated upon losing its last colony after first establishing one.
Your result and score are frozen. Further play will not change them.
